abstract: First live use of the automated action logging system for the actions of the current tick.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import json

TICK_TO_LOG = 32
LOG_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/log_actions.py"

actions_to_log = [
    {"type": "storage_read", "target": "telos/action_log.json", "metadata": {"purpose": "verification"}},
    {"type": "submit", "target": "1", "metadata": {"eval_id": 69, "title": "AOS: Complete Logging Test, Activate Live Logging"}}
]

actions_json_string = json.dumps(actions_to_log)
command = ["python", LOG_SCRIPT_PATH, str(TICK_TO_LOG), actions_json_string]
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
